title: Eggplant and Mozzarella Puff Pastry Bake
subtitle: a big pie for the whole family
description: Two sheets of puff pastry filled with roasted eggplant, tomato, pizza sauce and mozzarella. Baked until golden and served hot.

steps.text: Slice the eggplants thickly and bake at 200°C with olive oil and coarse salt for 15-20 minutes, until browned. Leave the oven on.
Slice the tomatoes to a medium thickness. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Lay one sheet of puff pastry on the tray and spread evenly with pizza sauce, leaving a clean border.
Arrange the eggplant slices, then the tomato slices on top, and sprinkle with coarse salt, olive oil and a few basil leaves.
Add a layer of mozzarella slices and cover with the second sheet of pastry. Press the edges of the two sheets together.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Cut a few diagonal slits in the pastry.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, until golden, and serve hot.
